title: LXC 111: add authentication and wire the systemd service so the panel runs and survives reboot
description:
On LXC 111, add a single authentication layer (password/token from config) in front of the whole panel, create the control-panel.service systemd unit, enable and start it, and confirm it listens on the container's address. On container 111.

[Engine split of ADD100 — 7 of 8] Done when the gate WORKS (operator decisions 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-08): every route and page of the panel asks for HTTP Basic credentials -- user `panel`, password the runner's secret `PANEL_PASSWORD` (the operator stores it in Settings -> Machines; the engine never sees it). Without credentials `pct exec 111 -- curl -s -o /dev/null -w %{http_code} http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/palworld-settings` answers `401`; with them `pct exec 111 -- curl -s -o /dev/null -w %{http_code} -u panel:"$PANEL_PASSWORD" http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/palworld-settings` answers `200`; and `pct exec 111 -- systemctl is-enabled control-panel.service` answers `enabled`.
